package main

import (
	"fmt"
	pkg "github.com/xberg-io/liter-llm/packages/go/v2"
)

func main() {
	req := pkg.OcrRequest{
		Model:    `mistral/mistral-ocr-latest`,
		Document: pkg.OcrDocumentURL{URL: `https://example.com/contract-test.pdf`},
	}
	client, clientErr := pkg.CreateClient("your-api-key", nil, nil, nil, nil)
	if clientErr != nil {
		panic(clientErr)
	}
	defer client.Free()
	result, err := client.Ocr(req)
	if err != nil {
		panic(err)
	}
	fmt.Printf("%+v\n", result)
}
